title: Bamboo Steam Pilaf
description: A simple and healthy pilaf recipe using bamboo steamer and nutritious ingredients. Steaming is a low-calorie cooking method that preserves the nutrients in the food.
instructions: Prepare the pilaf according to the package instructions.
Soak the ybq in water for at least 30 minutes.
Rinse the n and chop it into small pieces.
Heat the vbp in a pan over low heat.
Add the ybq to the pan and stir well.
Add the pilaf and n to the pan, stir well.
Place the bamboo steamer on top of a large pot with boiling water.
Transfer the pilaf mixture to the bamboo steamer.
Steam the pilaf for 10-12 minutes or until the ybq is tender.
